description: Deterministic BM25-only replay fixture for the #1833 CI quality gate. Reuses the audited corpus_v2 fixture corpus; relevance is declared per case as file globs (relevant_globs) resolved to chunk content_hashes at refresh time. No embedder is downloaded (embedding.provider=none); as_of is pinned far in the future so temporal decay is stable.

case_defs.name: corpus-postmortem-path-token
case_defs.note: #2224 sensitivity case. 'postmortem' is a filename-shaped word: twelve corpus files carry it in their path and only these two carry it in their prose, so it isolates what source_file contributes. Before the fix an unqualified MATCH searched both columns and the top ten were ten path-only matches with neither prose file present; the MATCH is now content-qualified, so the prose files are the whole result. Without a case of this shape the gate is blind to which columns are searched at all - it reported 12/12 unchanged for the very commit that changed them. A multi-term query does not work here: the AND-first strategy filters the path-only rows out before ranking, so the case has to be the single path-shaped term.
